name: Evelyn Regner - Après le considérant 7 - Am 86
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive on Business in Europe: Framework for Income Taxation (BEFIT)
part_text: (7 a) The Union should actively engage in international negotiations with a view to promoting the global harmonisation of rules and the allocation of taxing rights based on a formula reflecting tangible factors such as labour, assets and sales. The ongoing negotiations within the United Nations on international tax cooperation are a unique and timely opportunity in that regard. In that context, the abstention of several Member States is regrettable and they should be strongly encouraged to participate constructively and proactively in those discussions.
